vanilla-background.name: Vanilla Background
vanilla-background.description: use the default popup background instead of a custom one

always-show-resize-corners.name: Always Show Resize Corners
always-show-resize-corners.description: by default resize corners are only visible on hover (meaning they are completely invisible on mobile), this makes them always show

no-top-separator.name: No Top Separator
no-top-separator.description: remove the black line separating the top bar from the main content

lock-scale.name: Lock Scale
lock-scale.description: keep close button and outline scaling consistent when resizing a popup with a locked asp3ect ration (e.g. grid controls)

special-zone-size.name: Special Zone Size
special-zone-size.description: *diameter* of resize corners/top bar in points (basically, higher number means larger area u can resize/move window from)
